back_blocks.md: Random mutations make some bacteria resistant to the antibiotic.

The resistant bacteria reproduce and pass on the resistance, so the resistant population grows.

front_blocks.md: How can the development of antibiotic resistance be reduced (Extended)?

back_blocks.md: Only use antibiotics when they are really needed (for example, not for viral infections), so that resistant bacteria are less likely to develop and spread.
